scripts.text: What's wrong?

scripts.text:

Oh, don't get me started!
I'm stuck here doing all the
work while the Lab Department Head goes out every freakin' day!
scripts.translation:
[科學家]
怎麼了...？！
唉，別提了！
我留在這兒幹所有的活兒，實驗室主管卻每天都出去！

While I'm slaving

woman. God...!

scripts.text:
[Scientist]

Later, man.
scripts.translation:
[科學家]

嗯。

[Scientist]
Man alive!

Department Head

some work for a change?!
scripts.translation:
[科學家]

主管就不能偶爾進來乾點活嗎？！

scripts.text:
[Scientist]
I mean, come on!
I shouldn't have to
carry his workload!
scripts.translation:
[科學家]

Get some mouthwash.

scripts.translation:

^333333*嘆氣*^000000

scripts.text:

Daddy's gonna
win some Apples
this time for sure!

[醉漢]
好好好...爸爸這次肯定能贏到蘋果！

scripts.translation:
[醉漢]

^3131FF依美樂的心臟^000000站在我這邊！衝啊！

[{0}]

[{0}]

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:
[醉漢]
哇!
蘋果！我的蘋果！
蘋果，我需要更多...！

scripts.text:
[{0}]

some of mine?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]

scripts.text:

with so few Apples!
I'm a high roller and
this is a high stakes game!
scripts.translation:
[醉漢]
什...？
只有這麼點蘋果我什麼都做不了！
我是個大賭徒，這是場高風險的遊戲！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Do you want
some of mine?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你要不要分我一些？

scripts.text:
[Drunken Man]

some of your Apples!
Yeeeeeeeeeeehaw!
I'm back, baby!
scripts.translation:
[醉漢]
什...？是的...
當然！快把你的蘋果給我一些！
耶嘿嘿嘿嘿！
我回來了，寶貝！

scripts.text:
[Drunken Man]
Now, to win!
Daddy needs love...

crappy to classy!
scripts.translation:
[醉漢]
現在，贏給他們看！
爸爸需要愛...
是時候從倒霉蛋變成風雲人物了！

scripts.text: ^3355FF*Rolling and rumbling*^000000

[Kaci]

scripts.text:
[Drunken Man]
Waaaaahhhhhhhhhh!
Waaaaaaahhhhhhh!
scripts.translation:
[醉漢]
哇!
哇!

scripts.translation:
[醉漢]
哇哈哈哈哈！

^333333*Hic-hic-hiccup!*^000000

[醉漢]
我是庫爾森堡！

scripts.text: So what was that about Ymir's Heart?
scripts.translation: 那關於依美樂的心臟是怎麼回事

[{0}]

scripts.translation:
[醉漢]

I'm not really
supposed to be talking
about this. As head of
the Laboratory, I'm sworn
to secrecy about Ymir's Heart.
scripts.translation:
[醉漢]
嘿嘿......
我本來不該談這個。作為實驗室主管，我發過誓要對依美樂之心保密。

scripts.text:
[Drunken Man]
But what do I care?!
All they want are the
results of my research!
They don't appreciate
my work at all! My title
is completely worthless!
scripts.translation:
[醉漢]
可我才不在乎呢！
他們只想要我的研究成果！
根本不賞識我的工作！
我的頭銜一點價值都沒有！

scripts.text:
[Drunken Man]
You don't know how long I've
been imprisoned in the lab and
that the work conditions just get worse and worse. Screw them! I'll keep getting paid as long as I show them some progress in our project!
scripts.translation:
[醉漢]
你不知道我被困在實驗室裡多久了，工作條件還越來越差。去他們的！只要我能向他們展示專案有進展，他們就會繼續付我薪水！

Ymir's Heart. It was found
a long time ago in ^3131FFEinbech^000000
and it's in our lab now.

[醉漢]
是啊，我們正在研究依美樂之心。
很久以前，它在^3131FF艾音貝赫^000000被發現，現在就在我們的實驗室裡。

scripts.text:
[Drunken Man]
Everyone knows it's supposed
to hold some legendary power,
but even I was surprised to see
what it was capable of. It's both terrible and miraculous, scary
and wondrous...
scripts.translation:
[醉漢]
大家都知道它蘊含著某種傳說中的力量，但連我都驚訝於它的能力。
既可怕又神奇，既令人恐懼又讓人驚歎...

scripts.text:
[Drunken Man]
So...
I figure...
It may even
have the power to
win me Dice games!
Bwahaha--^333333*Hiccup!*^000000
scripts.translation:
[醉漢]
所以...
我想...
它甚至能讓我贏骰子！
哈哈--^333333*打嗝!*^000000

who's always mumbling
something to himself.

angry, but other times he looks
awfully depressed. He must have
lived through some really horrible experience. I can't help but feel really sorry for the old guy.
scripts.translation:
[年輕男子]
有時他看起來很憤怒，但其他時候又顯得非常沮喪。
他一定經歷過一些非常可怕的事情。
我不禁為這位老人感到難過。

[Young Man]

that old act that way, but
it makes me wonder what
could have happened to him.

Our city must just be
another place where
you'll stay no longer
than a few days.

[卡拉]
你好，冒險者。
我們的城市，想必只是你旅途中停留幾天的地方吧。

scripts.text:
[Calla]
You must have so much
freedom. I envy you. I can't
do what I want to do. I don't
even have the courage to tell
my family what I really want,
much less change things here...
scripts.translation:
[卡拉]
你一定很自由吧。
我好羨慕你。
我無法隨心所欲地生活，甚至沒有勇氣告訴家人我真正的想法，更別提改變這裡的現狀了...

scripts.text:
[Calla]
How is it like?
Going wherever you
please, following your
heart's true desire?
What I would give to
be able to do that...
scripts.translation:
[卡拉]
那種感覺怎麼樣？
隨心所欲地旅行，追隨內心真正的渴望？
我多麼希望能做到那樣啊...

scripts.text:
[Calla]
Thank you so much!
I'll try my best to convince
my parents to accept our
relationship. It'll be hard,
but it's a good first step~
scripts.translation:
[卡拉]
非常感謝你！
我會盡力說服父母接受我們的關係。
雖然很難，但這已經是好的開始了~

scripts.text:
[Calla]
I hope that we can all
work together to improve
relations between Einbech
and Einbroch. The hatred
between our towns must end...
scripts.translation:
[卡拉]
我希望我們大家能共同努力，改善艾音貝赫和艾音布羅克兩座城市之間的關係。
兩城之間的仇恨必須結束...

scripts.text:
[Calla]
I really appreciate
what you've done for
all of us. I'll be praying
for your safety, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[卡拉]
我非常感激你為我們所做的一切。
我會為你祈禱，保佑你平安，冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Calla]
I just heard from my mother
that she's planning to have
tea with Klitzer! I'm sure that
I have you to thank for this~
scripts.translation:
[卡拉]
我剛聽母親說，她打算和克利策一起喝茶！
這肯定多虧了你~

scripts.text:
[Calla]
I never dreamed that
something as wonderful
as this could happen.
I'm so happy, I could cry...
I'll always be grateful
for what you've done.
scripts.translation:
[卡拉]
我做夢也沒想到會發生這麼美好的事。
我高興得都要哭了...
我會永遠感激你為我做的一切。

scripts.text:
[Calla]
I feel like such a fool,
thinking it was all hopeless.
I'll be doing my best to have
my parents accept Klitzer and
someday we'll be married~
scripts.translation:
[卡拉]
我真覺得自己像個傻瓜，以為一切都無望了。
我會盡力讓父母接受克利策，總有一天我們會結婚的~

scripts.text:
[Calla]
There isn't much that I can
give you, but I can show you
one of my family's secrets.
It's an invigorating massage
technique that makes you a lot
healthier in only ten seconds.
scripts.translation:
[卡拉]
我沒什麼能給你的，但我可以向你展示我們家的一個秘密。
那是一種令人精神振奮的按摩技巧，只需十秒鐘就能讓你感覺更健康。

scripts.text:
[Calla]
Well, please take
off your equipment
and stand still while
I give the massage. It
might hurt a bit at first...
scripts.translation:
[卡拉]
那麼，請脫下裝備，站好別動，讓我給你按摩。
剛開始可能會有點疼...

scripts.text:
^3355FF*Rub Rub Rub*
*Knead Knead Knead*
*Crrack C-c-c--c-crack*
*Crack Crack Crrrrrrack*
*Rub Crrraaaaaaaaaack*^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF*擦擦 擦擦 擦擦*
*揉揉 揉揉 揉揉*
*咔嚓、咔嚓、咔嚓*
*咔嚓 咔嚓 咔嚓*
*擦擦——咔嚓!*^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ooooooooh...
I feel sooo
sore and yet
soooooo good.
Wait. Now I just
feel goooood~
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
噢噢噢噢...
感覺好酸，但是好舒服。
等等。
我現在只覺得好舒服~

scripts.text:
[Calla]
So how was it?
I hope it was refreshing.
Please understand that
it's the best thing I can
give you to show my gratitude.
scripts.translation:
[卡拉]
感覺怎麼樣？
希望讓你感到神清氣爽。
請理解，這是我為了表達感激能給你的最好的東西了。

scripts.text:
[Calla]
Once again,
thank you so
much, {0}.
I'll always pray for
your safety on your
your adventures~
scripts.translation:
[卡拉]
再次感謝你，{0}。
無論你踏上怎樣的冒險旅程，我都會一直為你的平安祈禱~

scripts.text:
[Calla]
You've spoken
with Klitzer? How
is he? What did he say?
scripts.translation:
[卡拉]
你和克利策談過了嗎？
他怎麼樣？
他說了什麼？

scripts.text:
[Calla]
Oh...?
He asked you to
deliver this flower
to me? How sweet~
Thank you very much,
kind adventurer~
scripts.translation:
[卡拉]
噢...？
他讓你把這朵花帶給我？
好貼心~非常感謝你，善良的冒險者~

scripts.text:
[Calla]
Ah, I'm so rude!
I've been calling you
''adventurer'' this whole
time you've been helping
me! Would you please
tell me your name?
scripts.translation:
[卡拉]
啊，我真失禮！
你一直在幫我，我卻一直叫你“冒險者”！
可以告訴我你的名字嗎？

scripts.text:
[Calla]
Ah, {0}!
Such a lovely name~
I promise that I won't ever
forget it. Oh, and if you pass by Einbech, would you thank Klitzer for the flower for me please?
scripts.translation:
[卡拉]
啊，{0}！
真是個好聽的名字~
我保證永遠不會忘記。
對了，如果你路過艾音貝赫，能替我謝謝克利策送的花嗎？

scripts.text:
[Calla]
A-and... And...
Please tell him that
I really miss him a lot.
^333333*Sob Sob...*^000000

[Calla]
I'm sorry...
I didn't catch that.
Would you please tell
me your name again?
scripts.translation:
[卡拉]
抱歉...
我沒聽清。
能請你再告訴我一次你的名字嗎？

scripts.text:
[Calla]
Oh my god...
Are you alright?
I just found out that
you ran into my father!
scripts.translation:
[卡拉]
天哪...
你沒事吧？
我剛剛得知你遇到了我父親！

scripts.text:
[Calla]
By all means,
try to avoid my dad!
He doesn't trust anyone
who's not considered part
of the upper class, even
adventurers like you!
scripts.translation:
[卡拉]
無論如何，儘量避開我爸爸！
他不信任所謂上流社會以外的人，連你這樣的冒險者也不例外！

scripts.text:
[Calla]
Would you please
take this Violin and
try to make it to Klitzer
this time? Thank you
for your help~
scripts.translation:
[卡拉]
請幫我帶上這把小提琴，這次務必把它交給克利策。
謝謝你的幫助~

scripts.text:
[Calla]
Oh, please send my
regards to Klitzer for me.
I wish I could comfort
him in person, but this
is the best I can do for now.
scripts.translation:
[卡拉]
哦，請幫我向克利策問好。
我希望能親自安慰他，但現在我只能做到這些了。

scripts.text:
[Calla]
You're the adventurer
from before, aren't you?
Sadly, there isn't much
to do around here. This
place is basically like
a prison to me...
scripts.translation:
[卡拉]
你是之前那位冒險者，對吧？
可惜，這裡沒什麼可做的。
對我來說，這地方簡直像座監獄...

scripts.text:
[Calla]
Oh, you've met Klitzer?
Isn't he so kind, and such
a perfect gentleman?
scripts.translation:
[卡拉]
哦，你見過克利策？
他是不是很善良，而且是個完美的紳士？

scripts.text:
[Calla]
I really wish I could
see him, but it's almost
impossible. My parents think
he's not good enough for me,
but they're wrong! What am
I going to do? Oh, Klitzer...
scripts.translation:
[卡拉]
我真的很想見他，但這幾乎是不可能的。
我父母覺得他配不上我，但他們錯了！
我該怎麼辦？
哦，克利策...

scripts.text:
[Calla]
Well, maybe I can't see
him, but would you give
my violin to Klitzer for me?
I used to play this for him
all the time...
scripts.translation:
[卡拉]
嗯，也許我見不到他，但你能幫我把這把小提琴交給克利策嗎？
我以前經常為他演奏...

scripts.text:
[Calla]
I'm sorry to trouble you,
but please understand
that I want to comfort my
Klitzer in any way that
I possibly can. Thank
you so much, adventurer...
scripts.translation:
[卡拉]
抱歉給你添麻煩了，但請理解，我想盡一切可能去安慰我的克利策。
非常感謝你，冒險者...

scripts.text:
[Calla]
Hello adventurer.
Our city must just be
another place where
you'll stay no longer
than a few days.
scripts.translation:
[卡拉]
你好，冒險者。
我們的城市，想必只是你旅途中停留幾天的地方吧。

scripts.text:
[Calla]
You must have so much
freedom. I envy you. I can't
do what I want to do. I don't
even have the courage to tell
my family what I really want,
much less change things here...
scripts.translation:
[卡拉]
你一定很自由吧。
我好羨慕你。
我無法隨心所欲地生活，甚至沒有勇氣告訴家人我真正的想法，更別提改變這裡的現狀了...

scripts.text:
[Calla]
How is it like?
Going wherever you
please, following your
heart's true desire?
What I would give to
be able to do that...
scripts.translation:
[卡拉]
那種感覺怎麼樣？
隨心所欲地旅行，追隨內心真正的渴望？
我多麼希望能做到那樣啊...

scripts.text:
[Klitzer]
Look out, world!
I'm gonna become
worthy of Calla's love!
Someday, maybe even her
parents will approve me!
scripts.translation:
[克利策]
看好了，世界！
我要變得配得上卡拉的愛！
總有一天，也許連她的父母也會認可我！

scripts.text:
[Klitzer]
Waaaah!
What should I wear?!
I can't for the life of me
figure this out! Something,
um, formal? I've never worn
anything like that before!
scripts.translation:
[克利策]
哇!
我該穿什麼？！
我怎麼也想不出來！
穿點...嗯，正式點的？
我以前從來沒穿過那種衣服！

scripts.text:
[Klitzer]
Wait, {0}.
What's that you've got
there? I've seen something
like that before. It's called
a Tuxedo, right? Something
like that would be perfect!
scripts.translation:
[克利策]
等等，{0}。
你拿著什麼？
我以前見過類似的東西。
那叫燕尾服，對吧？
那種衣服正合適！

scripts.text: Give it to him.
scripts.translation: 給他

scripts.text: Ignore Him.
scripts.translation: 無視他

scripts.text:
[Klitzer]
I can have this?
Oh, thank you so much!
Finally, I have something
nice enough to wear to meet
Calla's mom! What a relief!
scripts.translation:
[克利策]
這個可以給我嗎？
哦，太感謝了！
終於，我有足夠體面的衣服去見卡拉的媽媽了！
真是鬆了一口氣！

scripts.text:
[Klitzer]
You've been helping me all
this time and I haven't properly expressed my gratitude. I'm sorry
if I've been too absorbed in my own problems. I may be poor, but I need to repay you somehow...
scripts.translation:
[克利策]
你一直幫著我，我卻沒好好表達感謝。
抱歉，我一直沉浸在自己的煩惱中。
雖然我可能很窮，但我必須想辦法報答你...

scripts.text:
[Klitzer]
Wait...
Why don't you have this
ore? I don't know how
valuable it is, but I know
that it's pretty rare. It may
even be useful to you later~
scripts.translation:
[克利策]
等等...你拿著這塊礦石吧。
我不知道它有多值錢，但我知道它相當稀有。
也許以後對你有用~

scripts.text:
[Klitzer]
{0},
you've really opened
my eyes. From now on,
I'll do my best to earn the
approval of Calla's parents and
become worthy of Calla's love.
scripts.translation:
[克利策]
{0}，你真是讓我大開眼界。
從現在開始，我會盡力獲得卡拉父母的認可，並變得配得上卡拉的愛。

scripts.text:
[Klitzer]
But how can I get
a Tuxedo? Ooh, I hope
it doesn't cost too much
zeny or I won't be able to
get one of those soon...
scripts.translation:
[克利策]
但我怎麼才能弄到一件燕尾服呢？
唉，希望它別太貴，不然我很快都買不起...

scripts.text:
[Klitzer]
Noooooo!
I've got to find
the perfect thing
to wear or Calla's
mother might ^FF0000hate^000000 me!
scripts.translation:
[克利策]
不不不！
我必須找到完美的衣服，否則卡拉的媽媽可能會^FF0000討厭^000000我！

scripts.text:
[Klitzer]
What am I gonna do?!
Okay, nothing too flashy
or revealing. Can't let her
think I'm wild, immature or
unpredictable. Should I
wear suspenders or a belt?!
scripts.translation:
[克利策]
我該怎麼辦啊？！
好吧，不能穿得太花哨，也不能太暴露。
不能讓她覺得我輕浮、幼稚或不靠譜。
我該穿揹帶還是繫腰帶？！

scripts.text:
[Klitzer]
Noooooo!
I've got to find
the perfect thing
to wear or Calla's
mother might ^FF0000hate^000000 me!
scripts.translation:
[克利策]
不不不！
我必須找到完美的衣服，否則卡拉的媽媽可能會^FF0000討厭^000000我！

scripts.text:
[Klitzer]
Think, Klitzer, think!
Okay, no fun colors.
I don't want her to
think I'm not serious
about Calla. Stripes
might be bad too...
scripts.translation:
[克利策]
想想看，克利策，想想看！
好吧，不要鮮豔的顏色。
我不想讓她覺得我對卡拉不夠認真。
條紋可能也不太好...

scripts.text:
[Klitzer]
Eh...?
What did you just say?
You did something for
the Kapellthaines?
scripts.translation:
[克利策]
咦...？
你剛才說什麼？
你為卡佩爾泰因家做過什麼事嗎？

scripts.text:
[Klitzer]
What...?
Did you just say
that Calla's mother
wants me to have tea
with her? Holy moley...!
scripts.translation:
[克利策]
什麼...？
你剛才說卡拉的母親想讓我去和她喝茶？
天哪...！

scripts.text:
[Klitzer]
Okay, okay.
I-I I'll need something
nice to wear, right? Oh.
Wow. This is so sudden!
W-what should I do?
scripts.translation:
[克利策]
好的，好的。
我...我需要穿得好看一點，對吧？
哦。
哇。這也太突然了！
我...我該怎麼辦？

scripts.text:
[Klitzer]
This monkey suit
that I've got on just
won't do! Arrrgh! But I've
already outgrown all of my
nice clothes already. Boy,
am I in a pickle...
scripts.translation:
[克利策]
我這身行頭可不行！啊！
可我以前那些體面的衣服都已經穿不下了。
真叫人發愁...

scripts.text:
[Klitzer]
*Sigh...*
What can I do to
get Calla's parents
to accept me as her
boyfriend? I can't
think of anything...
scripts.translation:
[克利策]
*嘆氣...*
我該怎麼做，才能讓卡拉的父母接受我做她的男朋友呢？
我想不出任何辦法...

scripts.text:
[Klitzer]
You've given her
the flower? That's
great! Thank you,
thank you so mu--
scripts.translation:
[克利策]
你已經把花給她了？
太好了！
謝謝你，真的非常感謝你——

scripts.text:
[Klitzer]
...Oh!
Gosh! I was thinking so
much about myself that
I forgot to ask you for your
name! I'm sorry for being
so knuckle-headed...
scripts.translation:
[克利策]
...哦！
天哪！
我一直只顧著想自己的事，竟然忘了問你的名字！
抱歉，我真是個大笨蛋...

scripts.text:
[Klitzer]
So...
What's your name?
scripts.translation:
[克利策]
那麼...
你叫什麼名字？

scripts.text:
[Klitzer]
{0}...
That's very nice. Thank you,
I'm really grateful for your help. Although I can't see Calla in
person, I can at least send
my regards if you help me.
scripts.translation:
[克利策]
{0}...這個名字真好聽。
謝謝你，真的很感激你的幫助。
雖然我無法親自見到卡拉，但如果你願意幫我，我至少可以向你轉達我的問候。

scripts.text:
[Klitzer]
I feel so much
better now. Oh!
When you have the
time, why don't you talk
to my mother? She always
likes meeting my friends.
scripts.translation:
[克利策]
我現在感覺好多了。
哦！
如果你有空的話，能不能和我的母親聊聊？
她總是喜歡見我的朋友。

scripts.text:
[Klitzer]
Hm...?
Oh, don't be
so nervous~
But would you please
tell me your name again?
I couldn't hear you...
scripts.translation:
[克利策]
嗯...？
哦，別那麼緊張~不過你能再告訴我一次你的名字嗎？
我剛才沒聽清...

scripts.text:
[Klitzer]
Have you left to
see Calla for me yet?
I'm sorry if I sound
pretty demanding...
scripts.translation:
[克利策]
你還沒去見卡拉嗎？
抱歉，我聽起來是不是有點太急切了...

scripts.text:
[Klitzer]
Anyway, please
remember to bring
Calla ^FF00001 Flower^000000 for me.
It doesn't need to be
fancy, an ordinary one
should be just fine.
scripts.translation:
[克利策]
總之，請記得幫我帶^FF00001朵花^000000給卡拉。
不需要太華麗，普通的花就很好了。

scripts.text:
[Klitzer]
What brings you here?
Aren't you tired of hearing
me moan and whine about
lost love? ^333333*Siiiiigh...*^000000
scripts.translation:
[克利策]
你怎麼來了？
難道你不聽我抱怨失戀聽膩了嗎？^333333*Siiiiigh...*^000000

scripts.text:
[Klitzer]
Hey, this violin...
Calla used to play
such beautiful music
on this for me. Did
she give this to you?
scripts.translation:
[克利策]
嘿，這把小提琴...卡拉以前經常用它為我演奏美妙的音樂。
是她給你的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Klitzer]
I see. Calla must have
known that I'm all broken up
right now. She's too good to
to me. How can she consider
my feelings before thinking
about herself?
scripts.translation:
[克利策]
原來如此。
卡拉一定知道我現在有多傷心。
她對我真是太好了。
她怎麼會先考慮我的感受，而不是她自己呢？

scripts.text:
[Klitzer]
I know I'm being
shameless, but I have
a favor to ask. Adventurer,
would you please send
Calla a present for me?
scripts.translation:
[克利策]
我知道這樣有點厚臉皮，但我有個請求。
冒險者，你能幫我給卡拉送份禮物嗎？

scripts.text:
[Klitzer]
All you need to do is
just give her ^FF00001 Flower^000000.
I don't have the zeny and
I don't think I'm welcome
at Kapellthaine Manor.
scripts.translation:
[克利策]
你只要給她^FF00001朵花^000000就行。
我沒錢，而且我想卡佩爾泰因莊園也不歡迎我。

scripts.text:
[Klitzer]
Here, in return, I'll
give you this health
massage. It's not a
big deal, but when I'm
done, your mind and body
will be refreshed. Here goes!
scripts.translation:
[克利策]
作為回報，我給你做個按摩吧。
不是什麼大事，不過做完後，你的身心都會煥然一新。
開始咯！

scripts.text:
^3355FF*Knead Knead*
*Rub Rub Rub Rub*
*Press Press Press*
*C-c-c-c-c-c-crack!*
scripts.translation:
^3355FF*揉揉 揉揉*
*擦擦 擦擦 擦擦 擦擦*
*按壓 按壓 按壓*
*咔嚓、咔嚓、咔嚓!*

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh--
Hell yeah!
That's the stuff!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦——
太爽了！
就是這個感覺！

scripts.text:
[Klitzer]
Would you please bring
1 Flower to Calla for me?
I'm sorry for troubling you...
scripts.translation:
[克利策]
拜託你幫我送1朵花給卡拉好嗎？
真不好意思，麻煩你了...

scripts.text:
[Klitzer]
^333333*Sigh*^000000
I really appreciate your
sympathy, but I'm merely
a coward and a fool.
scripts.translation:
[克利策]
^333333*嘆氣*^000000
我很感激你的同情，但我只是個膽小鬼和傻瓜。

scripts.text:
[Klitzer]
Yeah...
I'm a coward for doing
nothing about my feelings
and an idiot for falling in love with such a high class girl in
the first place... Oh, Calla...
scripts.translation:
[克利策]
是啊...我對自己的感情什麼也不敢做，真是個膽小鬼；一開始就愛上如此高貴的女孩，更是個傻瓜...啊，卡拉...

scripts.text:
[Klitzer]
That faintly sweet
and pleasant scent...
It's just like the fragrance
they use in Calla's house.
scripts.translation:
[克利策]
那淡淡而愉悅的香氣...就像卡拉家裡使用的那種香味。

scripts.text:
[Klitzer]
Ah, so you visited
Calla in Einbroch?
I miss her sooo much!
Is she doing alright?
scripts.translation:
[克利策]
啊，你去艾音布羅克看望卡拉了嗎？
我好想她啊！
她最近還好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Klitzer]
Calla's so beautiful.
And she's so lovely.
Every time I close my
eyes, I can still see
her lovely smile.
scripts.translation:
[克利策]
卡拉那麼美麗。
她那麼可愛。
每次我閉上眼睛，依然能看到她那迷人的微笑。

scripts.text:
[Klitzer]
I'm sorry if I sound
silly, but I can't help
it. I know I'm acting like
a complete idiot. But I'd
give anything to see her...
scripts.translation:
[克利策]
如果我聽起來很傻，請見諒，但我控制不住。
我知道自己像個徹頭徹尾的白痴。
但我願意付出一切去見她...

scripts.text:
[Klitzer]
Just...
Just don't listen
to anything I say.
I'm just a poor fool
in love with the wrong
person. That has to be it...
scripts.translation:
[克利策]
只是...
別把我說的話當真。
我不過是個愛上了不該愛之人的可憐傻瓜。
一定是這樣...

scripts.text:
[Klitzer]
Is there something
that you really want
in life, but it's just
beyond your grasp?
scripts.translation:
[克利策]
生活中有沒有你非常渴望，卻遙不可及的東西？

scripts.text:
[Klitzer]
I wish I were more
like you adventurers.
People like you never
seem to give up, no matter
what the obstacles may be.
But I'm so helpless...
scripts.translation:
[克利策]
我真希望能像你們冒險者一樣。
像你們這樣的人，無論遇到什麼障礙，似乎從不放棄。
但我卻如此無助...

scripts.text:
[Klitzer]
I can't even see
the one person that
I love. We've just so
different that it's not
even possible anymore...
scripts.translation:
[克利策]
我甚至見不到自己愛的人。
我們實在太不一樣了，已經不可能在一起了...

scripts.text:
[Megass]
You again?!
What do you
want from me?!
scripts.translation:
[梅加斯]
又是你？！
你想從我這裡得到什麼？！

scripts.text:
[Megass]
Guards...!
Sweep the driveway with
this guy's face and keep
punching the stomach
until there's nothing
left to throw up!
scripts.translation:
[梅加斯]
衛兵...！
用這傢伙的臉把車道擦乾淨，再往他肚子上猛揍，直到他什麼也吐不出來為止！

scripts.text:
[Megass]
That's...
That's my
daughter's Violin.
I gave that to her
for her sweet sixteen...
scripts.translation:
[梅加斯]
那是...
那是我送給女兒的小提琴。
我在她十六歲生日時送給她的...

scripts.text:
[Megass]
It's bad enough to
intrude into my house,
but to steal from my Calla?!
You've crossed the line, punk!
Guards! Get over here!
scripts.translation:
[梅加斯]
闖入我家已經夠糟糕了，竟然還偷我卡拉的東西？！
你越界了，臭小子！
衛兵！過來！

scripts.text:
[Megass]
Men, I want you to
knock the wind out
of this fool and anything
else that might be inside!
Make sure that if this punk
wakes up, it won't be today!
scripts.translation:
[梅加斯]
夥計們，把這傢伙打得喘不過氣來，再把他肚子裡的東西也打出來！
確保這臭小子醒來時，已經不是今天了！

scripts.text:
[Megass]
How dare you...
A vagabond like
you setting foot
into my home!?
Unthinkable!
scripts.translation:
[梅加斯]
你竟敢...
像你這樣的流浪漢踏進我的家！？
簡直不可思議！

scripts.text:
[Megass]
Leave immediately
before I report you
to the authorities
for trespassing!
scripts.translation:
[梅加斯]
立刻離開！
否則我就以非法闖入的罪名將你上報給當局！

scripts.text:
[Satra]
I understand that my
home is extravagantly
splendid and to approach
any Kappelthaine is an
honor to most commoners.
scripts.translation:
[薩特拉]
我知道，我家富麗堂皇。對大多數平民來說，能接近任何一位卡佩爾泰因家族的人都是一種榮幸。

scripts.text:
[Satra]
However, Klitzer
has no reason to feel so
intimidated. Tell the poor
boy that he's earned the
honor of speaking with me.
scripts.translation:
[薩特拉]
不過，克利策沒有理由感到如此膽怯。
告訴那個可憐的孩子，他已贏得了與我交談的榮幸。

scripts.text:
[Satra]
Ho ho ho ho~
Welcome adventurer,
I so enjoy our little chats.
Hors d'oeuvre?
scripts.translation:
[薩特拉]
呵呵呵呵~
歡迎，冒險者。
我很喜歡和你閒聊。
來點開胃菜嗎？

scripts.text:
[Satra]
Oh! You can't enjoy
any food in that state!
Your hands are atrociously
grimy! May I ask why?
scripts.translation:
[薩特拉]
哦！
你這樣可沒法享用食物！
你的手髒得要命！
能告訴我為什麼嗎？

scripts.text:
[Satra]
Ah~
In my excitement,
I nearly forgot that
I asked you to bring
Coals to me again!
My apologies~
scripts.translation:
[薩特拉]
啊~我一興奮，差點忘了又讓你給我帶煤來了！
抱歉~

scripts.text:
[Satra]
You've brought so much Coal
to me, I'm convinced that you're much more diligent than those
languid peasants in Einbech.
I appreciate that you've labored so much to win my favor.
scripts.translation:
[薩特拉]
你帶給我這麼多煤，我確信你比艾音貝赫那些懶散的農民勤快得多。
我很感激你如此辛苦地為我效勞。

scripts.text:
[Satra]
Hm, what was that?
Someone else provided
these Coals and you were
only delivering them? Then
who actually gathered these?
scripts.translation:
[薩特拉]
嗯，你剛才說什麼？
這些煤是別人提供的，你只是負責運送？
那實際收集煤的人是誰？

scripts.text:
[Satra]
Ah, Klitzer?
I must say, that's
a very humble name.
Yet it's so familiar...
scripts.translation:
[薩特拉]
啊，克利策？
不得不說，這是一個非常謙遜的名字。
但聽起來很耳熟...

scripts.text:
[Satra]
Ah, I recall there
was a hooligan that
has been pestering my
daughter named Klitzer.
Perhaps they are one
and the same. Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[薩特拉]
啊，我想起來了，有個叫克利策的惡棍，一直在騷擾我的女兒。
也許他們就是同一個人。
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Satra]
I remember that he was
rather shabby looking and
lacked any semblance of
etiquette whatsoever. Clearly,
he is a fool and a coward, but now I see that he is sincere.
scripts.translation:
[薩特拉]
我記得他看起來相當邋遢，而且完全不懂禮儀。
顯然，他是個傻瓜和懦夫，但現在我看到他是真誠的。

scripts.text:
[Satra]
It might not be possible
to let him go out with my
daughter straight away, but
I will invite him for a spot of
tea. And if Calla likes him,
well, he must be special.
scripts.translation:
[薩特拉]
也許我還不能馬上答應他和女兒交往，但我會請他來喝杯茶。
如果卡拉喜歡他，那他肯定有過人之處。

scripts.text:
[Satra]
For a humble peasant,
this must be like a dream
come true! And to have tea
with Klitzer. Oh, what would
the girls say? Ah, but I did
marry that oafish Megass~
scripts.translation:
[薩特拉]
對一個卑微的農民來說，這一定像夢想成真！
還能和克利策喝茶。
哦，姑娘們會怎麼說呢？
啊，不過我確實嫁給了那個粗魯的梅加斯~

scripts.text:
[Satra]
Anyway, when you next
meet Klitzer, please tell
him to pay me a visit soon.
Oh, and remind him to dress
appropriately for this special
occasion. Ho ho ho ho ho~
scripts.translation:
[薩特拉]
總之，下次見到克利策時，請告訴他儘快來拜訪我。
哦，還要提醒他為這個特殊場合穿得得體一些。
呵呵呵呵呵~

scripts.text:
[Satra]
I beg your pardon?
{0}? Oh my...
I believe I may have
misheard you. Ho ho ho ho~
scripts.translation:
[薩特拉]
請原諒？
{0}？天哪...
我想我可能聽錯了。呵呵呵呵~

scripts.text:
[Satra]
Ho ho ho ho~
Welcome adventurer,
I so enjoy our little chats.
Hors d'oeuvre?
scripts.translation:
[薩特拉]
呵呵呵呵~歡迎，冒險者，我很享受我們的小小閒聊。
來點開胃菜嗎？

scripts.text:
[Satra]
Ah...
It seems you've
forgotten your ^FF0000Coals^000000.
A silly mistake, but one
I'm willing to overlook.
scripts.translation:
[薩特拉]
啊...
看來你忘了帶^FF0000煤^000000。
是個愚蠢的錯誤，但我願意原諒。

scripts.text:
[Satra]
Why hello~
Your visits have
recently been quite
delightful, fair adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[薩特拉]
你好~你最近的拜訪非常愉快，勇敢的冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Satra]
Continue to show
your appreciation
and dedication to me
and you'll soon be known
to be my most favored
commoner. Ho ho ho ho~
scripts.translation:
[薩特拉]
繼續向我展示你的感激和奉獻，你很快就會成為我最受寵愛的平民。
呵呵呵呵~

scripts.text:
[Satra]
I'm sure you've noticed
the strained relationship
between Einbroch and Einbech
by now. It's a shame, really.
scripts.translation:
[薩特拉]
我相信你已經注意到艾音布羅克和艾音貝赫之間緊張的關係了。
這真是令人遺憾。

scripts.text:
[Satra]
As Einbroch grew wealthier
and Einbech became more
destitude, the affluent began
despising the impoverished.
I suppose it follows that the poor started to resent the rich.
scripts.translation:
[薩特拉]
隨著艾音布羅剋日益富裕、艾音貝赫日漸貧困，富人開始蔑視窮人。
我想窮人開始怨恨富人，也是順理成章。

scripts.text:
[Satra]
It might be said that
both towns have been
trying to take advantage
of each other, but it's
clear that Einbroch has
always had the upper hand.
scripts.translation:
[薩特拉]
或許可以說，兩個城鎮都在試圖佔對方的便宜，但很明顯，艾音布羅克一直佔據著上風。

scripts.text:
[Satra]
In fact, because of
this rift between our
cities, our families are
taught not to associate
with the people of Einbech.
scripts.translation:
[薩特拉]
事實上，由於我們兩個城市之間的裂痕，我們的家族被教導不要與艾音貝赫的人交往。

scripts.text:
[Satra]
Now, I believe that most
people who live in Einbech
are peons, but that does not
mean I will not give them a
chance to prove their worth.
scripts.translation:
[薩特拉]
現在，我相信大多數住在艾音貝赫的人都是平民，但這並不意味著我不會給他們一個證明自身價值的機會。

scripts.text:
[Satra]
Why should I deprive
the lowly of my gracious
presense if they prove
themselves meritable?
Ho ho ho ho~
scripts.translation:
[薩特拉]
如果那些卑微的人能證明自己值得，我何必剝奪他們承蒙我恩寵的機會？
呵呵呵呵~

scripts.text:
[Satra]
Oh, that was scrumptious!
If you wish to pay me another
visit, don't forget to bring some Coal with you. Tah tah~
scripts.translation:
[薩特拉]
啊，真美味！
如果你還想再來拜訪，別忘了帶上煤哦。再見啦~

scripts.text:
[Satra]
Why hello~
Your visits have
recently been quite
delightful, fair adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[薩特拉]
你好~你最近的拜訪非常愉快，勇敢的冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Satra]
Oh, my apologies!
I suppose you're just
here for sight seeing,
or perhaps you're running
some sort of adventurer's
errand. Am I right?
scripts.translation:
[薩特拉]
哦，抱歉！
我想你只是來觀光，或者是在執行某種冒險者的任務。
我猜對了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Satra]
I know you well enough
to know that you wouldn't
be so rude as to stop by
and chat without bringing
any ^FF0000Coal^000000. Ho ho ho ho~
scripts.translation:
[薩特拉]
我很瞭解你，知道你不會這麼無禮，不帶任何^FF0000煤^000000就停下來閒聊。
呵呵呵呵~

scripts.text:
[Satra]
^333333*Titter~*^000000
Why, if it isn't my
intrepid adventurer.
Ho ho ho ho~
scripts.translation:
[薩特拉]
^333333*竊笑~*^000000
哎呀，這不是我那勇敢的冒險者嗎。
呵呵呵呵~

scripts.text:
[Satra]
My word!
Why are you carrying
all of that dirty Coal
with you? You poor,
impoverished thing.
scripts.translation:
[薩特拉]
天哪！
你為什麼帶著這麼多髒煤？
真是個可憐又窮困的人。

scripts.text:
[Satra]
Oh! Dear me,
I've nearly forgotten~
How divinely silly of me!
Once again, I graciously
accept your small gift on
behalf of the Kappellthaines.
scripts.translation:
[薩特拉]
哦！
天哪，我差點忘了~我真是糊塗得可愛！
再一次，我寬宏大量地代表卡佩爾泰因家族接受了你的小禮物。

scripts.text:
[Satra]
Let me share a little
bit of history concerning
our lovely Einbroch. At one
time, there was only Einbech,
the mining village. You can
imagine how long ago that was.
scripts.translation:
[薩特拉]
讓我分享一點關於我們可愛的艾音布羅克的歷史。
曾經，只有艾音貝赫，一個採礦村莊。
你可以想像那是多久以前的事了。

scripts.text:
[Satra]
However, the minerals
and ores mined in Einbech
need to be processed and
refined in factories that were
all built in a nearby industrial complex which became Einbroch.
scripts.translation:
[薩特拉]
然而，在艾音貝赫開採的礦物和礦石需要在工廠中進行加工和精煉，這些工廠都建在附近的工業區，後來成為了艾音布羅克。

scripts.text:
[Satra]
Now every citizen in
Einbroch is wealthy and
it's well known that there
is a higher standard of
living here than in Einbech.
scripts.translation:
[薩特拉]
現在，艾音布羅克的每一位市民都很富裕，眾所周知，這裡的生活水平比艾音貝赫高。

scripts.text:
[Satra]
Goodness, I believe
it's time for a spot of tea~
The next time you wish to have
an audience with me, it would
behoove you to bring another
gift of Coal. Toodles~
scripts.translation:
[薩特拉]
天哪，我想該喝點茶了~下次你想與我見面時，最好再帶一份煤作為禮物。
再見~

scripts.text:
[Satra]
^333333*Titter~*^000000
Why, if it isn't my
intrepid adventurer.
Ho ho ho ho~
scripts.translation:
[薩特拉]
^333333*竊笑~*^000000
哎呀，這不是我那勇敢的冒險者嗎。
呵呵呵呵~

scripts.text:
[Satra]
My apologies, but you
must first prove to me
that you are worthy of
conversation. Why don't
you deliver more of those
^FF0000Coals^000000, mmm?
scripts.translation:
[薩特拉]
抱歉，但你必須先向我證明你有資格與我交談。
為什麼不再送一些^FF0000煤^000000呢，嗯？

scripts.text:
[Satra]
After all, I have no other
means of knowing whether
or not you appreciate the time
I sacrifice by socializing with
someone of your status.
Ho ho ho ho~
scripts.translation:
[薩特拉]
畢竟，我沒有其他方法知道你是否感激我犧牲時間與像你這樣地位的人社交。
呵呵呵呵~

scripts.text:
[Satra]
My, you've already
brought the Coal?
How charmingly
prompt you are~
scripts.translation:
[薩特拉]
哎呀，你已經帶來煤了？
你真是太守時了~

scripts.text:
[Satra]
On behalf of the
Kappellthaine family,
I shall ignore your lowly
status and graciously
accept your small gift.
Ho ho ho ho~
scripts.translation:
[薩特拉]
代表卡佩爾泰因家族，我將無視你卑微的地位，寬宏大量地接受你的小禮物。
呵呵呵呵~

scripts.text:
[Satra]
Do you hail from
Einbech, adventurer?
Ah, the Rune-Midgarts
kingdom! I've visited your
country. It's quite quaint
and Jawaii is very lovely.
scripts.translation:
[薩特拉]
冒險者，你來自艾音貝赫嗎？
啊，盧恩·米德加茲王國！我去過你的國家。
那裡相當古樸，海伊洛也很可愛。

scripts.text:
[Satra]
Well, I shall try to
find some use for these.
I'm afraid the gift I've asked
from you isn't very practical.
How is Coal usually used?
Ah, I have a novel idea!
scripts.translation:
[薩特拉]
好吧，我會設法利用這些的。
恐怕我向你索要的禮物並不實用。
煤通常是怎麼使用的？
啊，我有一個新奇的想法！

scripts.text:
[Satra]
Wouldn't it be
intoxicatingly wild if
Megass were to hold one
of those social functions that
the lower classes are so fond
of? A 'barbeque,' yes?
scripts.translation:
[薩特拉]
要是梅加斯能舉辦一場那些下等人特別喜歡的社交活動，那該多刺激啊？
沒錯，就是“燒烤”。

scripts.text:
[Satra]
In any case, if you
bring me more of that
Coal, you would be even
more favored by me and
you'll become a recipient
of my good graces. Ho ho~
scripts.translation:
[薩特拉]
總之，如果你再給我帶些煤來，我會更加青睞於你，讓你成為我恩寵的受益者。
呵呵~

scripts.text:
[Satra]
A wandering adventurer...?
How ravishingly delightful!
You must have risked life and
limb to sneak past my husband
to enjoy the captivating sights
of my home. Ho ho ho ho~
scripts.translation:
[薩特拉]
一位四處遊歷的冒險者...？
真是令人陶醉！
你一定冒著生命危險，偷偷躲過我丈夫，只為欣賞我家迷人的景緻。呵呵呵呵~

scripts.text:
[Satra]
Since you're a very
unique guest, I shall
give you a unique honor
and deign to converse
with you, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[薩特拉]
既然你是位非常獨特的客人，我將賜予你獨特的榮耀，並屈尊與你交談，冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Satra]
Einbech exists to provide
my family with coal and
materials from their mines.
It's a natural law: workers
must be led by a chosen few.
scripts.translation:
[薩特拉]
艾音貝赫存在的意義，就是為我家供應煤和礦山出產的材料。
這是自然法則：工人理應由少數天選之人領導。

scripts.text:
[Satra]
It's delightfully
ludicrous to see those
workers aspire to reach
our heights of social
prestige. Ho ho ho ho~
scripts.translation:
[薩特拉]
看到那些工人渴望達到我們的社會地位，真是令人發笑的荒謬。
呵呵呵呵~

scripts.text:
[Satra]
Oh, I haven't spoken to
someone from a lower
class in ages! It feels
so forbiddenly exciting!
scripts.translation:
[薩特拉]
哦，我已經很久沒有和下等人說話了！
感覺真是禁忌又刺激！

scripts.text:
[Satra]
Well adventurer, that's 
the end of our informal
chat. I'll even grant you
full permission to boast
of the fact that you've
spoken to Lady Satra.
scripts.translation:
[薩特拉]
好了，冒險者，我們的閒聊到此為止。
我甚至准許你誇耀自己曾與薩特拉女士交談過。

scripts.text:
[Satra]
If you do wish for
me to share words with
you once more, prove to
me that you're worthier
than the other peons of
my graceful presense.
scripts.translation:
[薩特拉]
如果你確實希望我再次與你分享言語，那就向我證明你比其他雜役更有價值。

scripts.text:
[Satra]
Oh, I have a marvelous
idea! Why don't you bring
me ^990000Coals^000000? It's not impossible
for someone like yourself, but
this kind of task will require
some effort on your part.
scripts.translation:
[薩特拉]
哦，我有個絕妙的主意！
給我帶些^990000煤炭^000000怎麼樣？
這對你來說不難，不過還是得花點工夫。

scripts.text:
[Satra]
Tah tah,
adventurer~
scripts.translation:
[薩特拉]
再見啦，冒險者~

scripts.text:
[Satra]
A wandering adventurer...?
How ravishingly delightful!
You must have risked life and
limb to sneak past my husband
to enjoy the captivating sights
of my home. Ho ho ho ho~
scripts.translation:
[薩特拉]
一位四處遊歷的冒險者...？
真是迷人又有趣！
你一定冒著生命危險，偷偷躲過我丈夫，只為欣賞我家的美景吧。呵呵呵呵~

scripts.text:
[Satra]
Since you're a very
unique guest, I shall
give you a unique honor
and deign to converse
with you, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[薩特拉]
既然你是位非常獨特的客人，我將賜予你獨特的榮耀，並屈尊與你交談，冒險者。

workers aspire to reach
our heights of social
prestige. Ho ho ho ho~
scripts.translation:

class in ages! It feels

scripts.translation:

這種禁忌感真刺激！

scripts.translation:

some effort on your part.

[Satra]
Tah tah,
adventurer~
scripts.translation:
[薩特拉]
再見啦，冒險者~

scripts.text:
[Satra]
A wandering
adventurer...?
How sinfully
intriguing!
Ho ho ho ho~
scripts.translation:
[薩特拉]
流浪的冒險者...？
真是罪惡又迷人！
呵呵呵呵~

scripts.text:
[Satra]
Oh, do not worry.
I'm sure the beauty of
my home has captured your
curiosity. My brutish excuse
for a husband would have you
beat if he found you...
scripts.translation:
[薩特拉]
哦，別擔心。
我想我家的美景勾起了你的好奇心。
要是我那個粗魯的丈夫發現你，他肯定會把你揍一頓...

scripts.text:
[Satra]
But I'm far more genteel
than Megass. You're more
than welcome to enjoy the
furnishings. Ho ho ho ho~
scripts.translation:
[薩特拉]
不過我比梅加斯優雅多了。
歡迎你欣賞這裡的陳設。呵呵呵呵~

scripts.text:
[Kaijeta]
My son learned
an awful lot from
your good example.
As a mother, I really
appreciate everything
you've done for him.
scripts.translation:
[凱傑塔]
我兒子從你的好榜樣中學到了很多。
作為母親，我真的感激你為他做的一切。

scripts.text:
[Kaijeta]
Well, adventurer,
I will be praying for
your safety wherever
your journeys may
take you.
scripts.translation:
[凱傑塔]
好了，冒險者，無論你的旅程將把你帶往何處，我都會為你的安全祈禱。

scripts.text:
[Kaijeta]
Thank you for helping
my son Klitzer. Sadly, the
little fool doesn't have any
clue when it comes to certain
things like choosing clothing.
He gets so nervous about it!
scripts.translation:
[凱傑塔]
謝謝你幫助我兒子克利策。
可惜，這個小傻瓜在某些事情上完全沒有概念，比如選擇衣服。
他為此非常緊張！

scripts.text:
[Kaijeta]
A man should wear nice
clothes, like a Formal Suit
or a Tuxedo, for important
meetings and special occasions.
Hopefully, he'll learn that soon.
scripts.translation:
[凱傑塔]
重要會面或特殊場合，男人應該穿體面的衣服，比如正式西裝或燕尾服。
希望他很快能學會這一點。

scripts.text:
[Kaijeta]
Thank you for helping
my son Klitzer. Sadly, the
little fool doesn't have any
clue when it comes to certain
things like choosing clothing.
He gets so nervous about it!
scripts.translation:
[凱傑塔]
謝謝你幫助我兒子克利策。
可惜，這個小傻瓜在某些事情上完全沒有概念，比如選擇衣服。
他為此非常緊張！

scripts.text:
[Kaijeta]
A man should wear nice
clothes, like a Formal Suit
or a Tuxedo, for important
meetings and special occasions.
Hopefully, he'll learn that soon.
scripts.translation:
[凱傑塔]
男人應該穿漂亮的衣服，比如西裝外套或燕尾服，用於重要的會議和特殊場合。
希望他很快能學到這些。

scripts.text:
[Kaijeta]
I can't bear to see the
petty hatred between our
two towns stop my son from
seeing the woman he loves...
scripts.translation:
[凱傑塔]
我無法忍受我們兩個城鎮之間的小仇恨阻止我兒子見到他愛的女人...

scripts.text:
[Kaijeta]
Thank you for helping my
son. He may look like a fool
for falling in love with someone from Einbroch, but he's an honest
hard working man.
scripts.translation:
[凱傑塔]
謝謝你幫助我兒子。
他可能因為愛上艾音布羅克的姑娘而顯得有點傻，但他是個誠實勤勞的人。

scripts.text:
[Kaijeta]
Then again, it was bound to
happen sometime. Einbech is
a very poor town while Einbroch
is a very rich town. I'd understand if you don't agree, but opposites attract sooner or later.
scripts.translation:
[凱傑塔]
不過，這種事遲早會發生。
艾音貝赫很貧窮，艾音布羅克卻很富裕。你若不認同，我也能理解，但相反的人終究會互相吸引。

scripts.text:
[Kaijeta]
^666666*Sigh...*^000000
If my son and Calla can
work things out, maybe it
would improve relations
between our two towns.
I certainly hope so...
scripts.translation:
[凱傑塔]
^666666*嘆氣...*^000000
如果我的兒子和卡拉能解決他們之間的問題，也許能改善我們兩個城鎮之間的關係。
我真心希望如此...

scripts.text:
[Kaijeta]
Still, I'm quite baffled!
I raised my son to have more
guts than to wallow in misery
when his heart's broken. And
I still have no idea how he got together with such a rich woman.
scripts.translation:
[凱傑塔]
不過我還是很納悶！
我把兒子培養得很有骨氣，不會因為失戀就一味消沉。
而且我至今不明白，他怎麼會和這麼有錢的姑娘在一起。

scripts.text:
[Kaijeta]
Do you have any idea
how we can put an end
to the hate between our
two towns? I don't want to
see this couple separated
because of such pettiness.
scripts.translation:
[凱傑塔]
你有沒有什麼辦法能結束我們兩個城鎮之間的仇恨？
我不想看到這對情侶因為這種小事而分開。

scripts.text:
[Kaijeta]
Welcome to my humble
abode, adventurer. I'm
sorry if I'm a poor host.
scripts.translation:
[凱傑塔]
歡迎來到我的簡陋住所，冒險者。
如果我是個糟糕的主人，請見諒。

scripts.text:
[Kaijeta]
As you can see, we have
to share this house with
other families so we don't
have much open space or
privacy. I'm afraid we can't
afford even basic comfort.
scripts.translation:
[凱傑塔]
如你所見，我們只能和其他家庭擠住在這棟房子裡，幾乎沒有空地，也沒有隱私。恐怕連基本的舒適生活都負擔不起。

scripts.text:
[Kaijeta]
For now, this is the best
we can do. We don't have
the zeny to buy a house or
land, so we have no choice
but to endure through this...
scripts.translation:
[凱傑塔]
目前，這是我們能做到的最好情況。
我們沒有Zeny買房或買地，所以只能忍受這種生活...

scripts.text:
[Keneshiotz]
This city is full of sky
high smokestacks and
the droning hum of machines.
scripts.translation:
[凱內希奧茨]
這座城市到處都是高聳入雲的煙囪和機器持續不斷的轟鳴聲。

scripts.text:
[Keneshiotz]
Sure, the air is polluted,
but I think it's a fair price
to pay for wealth and a
modern life of comfort.
Screw the environment!
scripts.translation:
[凱內希奧茨]
沒錯，空氣汙染了，但我覺得這是換取財富和現代舒適生活應付出的代價。
去他的環境！

scripts.text:
[Keneshiotz]
I'd much rather live like
this than end up like those
backwards vagrants in that
filthy Einbech. Don't they
know that money makes
the world go 'round?
scripts.translation:
[凱內希奧茨]
我寧願住在這裡，也不想變成艾音貝赫那些落後的流浪漢。
他們難道不知道金錢能讓世界運轉嗎？

scripts.text:
[Catzllanpu]
^333333*Sigh...*^000000
Simple pleasures.
They're what make
life worth living,
you know?
scripts.translation:
[卡茨蘭普]
^333333*嘆氣...*^000000
平淡的快樂。
你知道嗎？正是這些讓生活值得繼續。

scripts.text:
[Catzllanpu]
It's enough for me just to
live a normal and happy life,
but everyone around me wants
to work harder and harder. If
you never take a rest, you're
killing yourself pretty slowly.
scripts.translation:
[卡茨蘭普]
對我來說，過普通而幸福的生活就足夠了，可身邊的人只想越來越拼命地工作。
從不休息，等於慢慢把自己累垮。

scripts.text:
[Catzllanpu]
I guess you can tell that
I don't have the worries
other people have about
money. It's great, but it's
not worth sacrificing the
quality of your life, right?
scripts.translation:
[卡茨蘭普]
你大概看得出來，我不像別人那樣為錢發愁。錢當然很好，但不值得拿生活品質去換，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Kesunboss]
Lady Calla is the
epitome of elegance,
a veritable goddess
of Einbroch.
scripts.translation:
[克孫博斯]
卡拉女士是優雅的化身，是艾音布羅克名副其實的女神。

scripts.text:
[Kesunboss]
Her gentle voice,
that angelic smile, her
kindness and warmth
towards other people
and above all...
scripts.translation:
[克孫博斯]
她溫柔的聲音，那天使般的微笑，她對別人的善良和溫暖，最重要的是...

scripts.text:
[Kesunboss]
Calla's family
is wealthy beyond
imagination! She's
perfect! I don't know who
she'll marry, but he'd be
a lucky gentleman, I'm sure.
scripts.translation:
[克孫博斯]
卡拉的家族富有得超乎想像！
她太完美了！
我不知道她會嫁給誰，但我相信他一定是一個幸運的紳士。

scripts.text:
[Kesunboss]
Lady Calla lives in a magnificent mansion that makes other houses
look like shacks in comparison.
Head north and then west from
here if you wish to marvel in its
beauty and elegance.
scripts.translation:
[克孫博斯]
卡拉女士住在一座宏偉的宅邸裡，和它相比，其他房子都像小棚屋。
想欣賞那裡的美景與雅緻，就從這裡往北再往西走。

scripts.text:
[Ellhenje]
Things might be
bad in this town
with the pollution
and the bullying
from Einbroch...
scripts.translation:
[艾爾亨傑]
這個城鎮的情況可能很糟糕，有汙染和來自艾音布羅克的欺凌...

scripts.text:
[Ellhenje]
But somehow, people
are able to get by. That's
because there's a guy
that everyone here likes...
scripts.translation:
[艾爾亨傑]
但不知怎的，人們還是能過下去。
那是因為這裡有一個大家都喜歡的人...

scripts.text:
[Ellhenje]
I'm talking about Klitzer!
He's almost too honest and
almost too diligent. But most
of all, he's the nicest guy~
scripts.translation:
[艾爾亨傑]
我說的是克利策！
他誠實得過了頭，勤奮得也過了頭。
但最重要的是，他是個最好不過的好人~

scripts.text:
[Ellhenje]
Klitzer was born in one of
Einbech's poorest families,
but he's usually happy and always thinks about others. I guess that's why people like to think of him
as representing all of Einbech.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾亨傑]
克利策出生在艾音貝赫最貧困的家庭之一，但他總是樂觀，也總替別人著想。
我想大家把他當作艾音貝赫的代表，正是因為如此。

scripts.text:
[Ellhenje]
Recently, something's
been bothering him. I'm
not sure, but I think only
woman troubles could make
a guy feel so glum. I hope he
feels better soon...
scripts.translation:
[艾爾亨傑]
最近，有些心事困擾著他。
我不確定，但我覺得只有女人的煩惱才能讓一個男人如此沮喪。
希望他能快點好起來...

scripts.text:
[Decii]
This is so
frustrating!
I'm surrounded
by all these ^FF0000people^000000!
scripts.translation:
[德西]
這太讓人抓狂了！
我周圍全是^FF0000人^000000！

scripts.text:
[Decii]
There's absolutely
no privacy in a city
this crowded! I guess
I should try to move
out as soon as I can.
scripts.translation:
[德西]
在這個擁擠的城市裡，完全沒有隱私可言！
我想我應該儘快搬出去。

scripts.text:
[Supineque]
Ugh...
I'm starving!
scripts.translation:
[蘇皮內克]
唉...
我快餓死了！

scripts.text:
[Supineque]
I haven't had food for so
long that my stomach is
beginning to digest itself!
This is horrible...
scripts.translation:
[蘇皮內克]
我已經很久沒吃東西了，我的胃開始消化自己了！
這太糟糕了...

scripts.text:
[Supineque]
I mean, I have
food that I can
eat today. But if
I finish it, what am
I gonna eat tomorrow?
scripts.translation:
[蘇皮內克]
我是說，我今天還有東西吃。
可要是吃完了，明天我吃什麼？
